4) Security & compliance (KMS/SSO/audit logs)
5) Success criteria & rollout plan

- Tue Jul 20: 10:00–11:30am PT
- Wed Jul 21: 2:00–3:30pm PT
- Thu Jul 22: 9:00–10:30am PT

Also tagging Marissa and Dylan (SEs) to lead the technical session. If there are any specific pre-reads or dataset details you want us to review ahead of time, send them over or drop in the shared Drive link below.
